about.label: Tropical View Ubud
about.title: An Oasis of Taste in the Heart of Ubud
about.description1: Tropical View Ubud offers a unique dining experience amidst the calming natural atmosphere of Ubud. Strategically located on Monkey Forest Street, we serve various Indonesian and international dishes, including Nasi Goreng, Crispy Fried Duck, and Rib-Eye Steak.
about.description2: With beautiful rice field views and a comfortable design, this place is perfect for enjoying breakfast, lunch, or dinner. We are open daily from 7:00 to 22:00.

aboutPage.label: Tropical View Ubud
aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.subtitle: Learn about our journey, our passion for food, and our love for nature.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: A Dream Born in Ubud
story.paragraph1: Tropical View Ubud was born from a simple dream — to create a place where guests could enjoy delicious food while being surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Ubud's rice terraces and tropical greenery.
story.paragraph2: Located on the famous Monkey Forest Street, our restaurant offers more than just a meal. It offers an experience — the gentle sound of nature, warm Balinese hospitality, and flavors that tell a story.
story.paragraph3: Since opening our doors, we have welcomed travelers from all over the world who come seeking authentic Indonesian cuisine and a tranquil atmosphere. Every dish we serve is prepared with locally sourced ingredients and traditional Balinese spices.

mission.label: What We Stand For
mission.title: Our Mission & Values
mission.description: Everything we do is guided by our commitment to quality, sustainability, and community.

authenticCuisine.title: Authentic Cuisine
authenticCuisine.description: We celebrate Indonesian culinary traditions while embracing international flavors. Every dish is crafted with respect for authentic recipes and the freshest local ingredients.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: We source our ingredients from local farmers and producers, supporting the Balinese community while minimizing our environmental footprint.

warmHospitality.title: Warm Hospitality
warmHospitality.description: Balinese hospitality is world-renowned for its warmth and generosity. We treat every guest like family, ensuring your experience is memorable from start to finish.

experience.label: The Experience
experience.title: Dining With a View
experience.paragraph1: Imagine savoring a plate of Nasi Goreng while gazing at lush green rice terraces stretching as far as the eye can see. At Tropical View Ubud, every table offers a window into the soul of Bali.
experience.paragraph2: Our restaurant is designed to blend seamlessly with nature. Open-air seating, natural materials, and the gentle sounds of the tropical forest create an atmosphere that calms the mind and delights the senses.
experience.paragraph3: Whether you're enjoying a leisurely breakfast, a business lunch, or a romantic dinner, the magic of Ubud surrounds you at every moment.
